header: Claude is about to make a git commit. Please review what will be committed:
question: As a Lucid engineer, do you understand and approve these changes?
rejection_note: Choosing No cancels the commit. Claude will stop and ask what you want changed.
staging_note: Note: this command also stages changes, so the exact set of files is decided at commit time. Unstaged changes to tracked files (and new files it adds) are included above.
summary_failed: Couldn't summarize the changes (git information was unavailable). Check them yourself with `git status` and `git diff --cached` before approving.
sensitive_warning: WARNING: {path} matches sensitive pattern {pattern}. Make sure it contains no secrets.
multiple_commits_note: This command makes {count} commits. Only the first one is summarized.
claude_instruction: Commits need human approval through the commit-approval prompt. If the user rejects a commit, do not retry it, reword it, or work around it (for example with a different git command, a script, or by committing again later). Stop and ask the user what they want changed.
